# Generic hygiene patterns, safe to publish: one case-insensitive JavaScript regular expression per line.
# Machine paths and e-mail addresses never belong in this tree.
# The names that must stay out (clients, partners, people) are NOT listed here, because listing them would
# publish them. They live in the private denylist: the MC_DENYLIST variable (an Actions secret in CI, one
# pattern per line) or ~/.config/mission-control/denylist.txt. scripts/denylist.mjs loads both.
/Users/
/home/[a-z]
[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}
